description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo. The pin is a release tag rather than a sha: petralabx/skills tags each merge to main with v<manifest.version>, so v1.6.15 is readable, immutable, and resolves to exactly one commit. Merge this pin only after petralabx/skills#48 is merged and the release-tag workflow has created v1.6.15. v1.6.15 makes project-researcher and guided-project-discovery save a plan that adds a project, or two or more buckets, as a Mission Control draft (TASK-4129). v1.6.11 to v1.6.14 added plx-brand, handoff and resume-workstream. v1.6.10 promoted deployed-pr-e2e company standards (speed classes, viewport matrix, API and security stamps, COS packs). v1.6.7 added skillparity. The pin is what colleagues resolve against, so a skill published to the catalog is not installable until this field moves. Provenance comes from the ref actually fetched. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
